name: Smartlead
summary: Cold email platform with unlimited mailboxes, AI warm-up, lead finding and deliverability infrastructure.
description: Smartlead sends cold email at scale across unlimited mailboxes with AI warm-up, and adds SmartProspect for verified leads, AI agents, dedicated sending servers and an AI dialer. It is used by agencies and outbound teams. A free trial is offered; plan prices were partly readable on the pricing page. The company publishes case studies and free tools for email authentication and deliverability. Its site offered 50% off the first month during this check.
